title: Getting Started with SvelteKit
excerpt: Learn the fundamentals of SvelteKit and build your first web application with this modern framework.

data.text: SvelteKit is a powerful framework for building web applications. It combines the simplicity of Svelte with a full-stack application framework.
In this guide, we'll explore the core concepts and build a simple application from scratch.

meta_description: A comprehensive guide to getting started with SvelteKit web development
